title: Account
publicLinkLead: Pick a username to get a short link to your profile. Anyone can open it, even without an account; stats and prices stay visible only to brands.
usernameHint: 3–30 characters: Latin letters, numbers, dots and underscores.
pageNotLive: Your page goes live after your profile is verified.
influencerLead: Your profile, portfolio and answers, as companies will see them.
brandLead: Your company profile, as influencers will see it.
deleteText: Your profile, photos, connected accounts and notifications are removed, and you are signed out everywhere. Your briefs and offers close and open applications are withdrawn. A Pro subscription stops right away, with no refund for the days left. This can’t be undone.
deleteConfirmText: Everything above happens at once and can’t be undone.
deletedToast: Your account is deleted. Take care.
settingsLead: Language, currency, notifications, the app and your password.
preferencesHint: Emails and notifications come in this language. Prices are shown in this currency.
previewNote: This is your profile as a company sees it. Your contacts open to a company only after it accepts you.
previewHidden: Companies can’t see your profile yet: it appears to them once it’s verified.
previewBrandNote: Influencers see this card on each of your briefs. On a confidential brief your name and logo stay hidden until you accept an influencer.
digestHint: New matching briefs or applicants, once a day. Payment and approval emails always arrive.
passwordHint: Changing it signs you out on other devices.
